scope: Live accessible company pages under Notion 企業研究: コンサル, 金融, メーカー. Active rows returned by existing unfiltered views; no archive/trash/version search.

method.row_enumeration: company catalog SQL initially; all ES tables and supplemental catalogs enumerated by saved view with page_size 100; every has_more false and no view filters
method.content: fetch each returned record; no child-page tags in fetched ES bodies; one employer prompt image inspected separately
method.normalization: replace whitespace runs with one space and trim; exact normalized entire-body equality only; reused answer portions across different pages remain, so variants are not independent compositions
method.status: Notion properties only; not independent proof of external submission
method.query_limit: SQL query_data_sources usage_limit_reached; no SQL retry; supported saved-view retrieval completed
method.retrieval_metadata: truncated and unknown_block_count metadata not supplied by fetch; fetched body markup checked; no unknown tags in ES answer bodies
method.privacy: No answer body, image file, private company properties, credentials or signed URLs saved in this repository
